findings.title: Quoted-topic author color uses the wrong lightness
findings.body: This rule previously lightened `$primary` by 30%, but the replacement uses 70% for the light-theme branch and 30% for the dark-theme branch. That makes the light-theme text much brighter than before and reverses the intended color adjustment; use the corresponding 30%/70% pair.

findings.title: Mobile modal text color is inverted from its existing value
findings.body: The original color lightened `$primary` by 70%, but this replacement uses 30% for the light-theme branch and 70% for the dark-theme branch. This changes the light-theme text to a substantially darker color and applies the intended dark-theme adjustment in reverse; preserve the 70%/30% pair.

findings.title: Mobile topic-map heading loses its original lightness
findings.body: This heading previously used a 20% lightness adjustment, but the replacement changes the light-theme branch to 50% and the dark-theme branch to 50%. The light-theme heading therefore becomes much lighter than before; the dark-theme branch should instead use the complementary 80% adjustment.

findings.title: Group member names use a different lightness than before
findings.body: The original light-theme name color used a 30% lightness adjustment, but the replacement uses 50% for both theme branches. This noticeably changes name colors in light themes; retain the original 30% adjustment and use its 70% counterpart for dark themes.

findings.title: Group member names use a different lightness than before
findings.body: The original light-theme name color used a 30% lightness adjustment, but the replacement uses 50% for both theme branches. This noticeably changes name colors in light themes; retain the original 30% adjustment and use its 70% counterpart for dark themes.
